gen-amatic-sc-gf-nokora: Amatic SC draws its lines like squeezed toothpaste, one unbroken stroke with the ends stopping well short of the stems. Nokora follows in sans-serif, with a dark band of lowercase and a wide s that never tightens.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noticia-text: Amatic SC's scrawled lines hold one weight from stem to curve, as if sketched quickly with a pen on paper. It wins on quirk, while Noticia Text, a serif, wins on dignity.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is a modern sans-serif with an inviting gap in its c and capitals barely taller than lowercase. Beside Amatic SC's hand-drawn, uniform-weight lines, it feels tidy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of each line's height with its lowercase and keeps a wide-open c, feeling modern and plain. Amatic SC, with tubelike strokes of constant weight, brings a rustic, quirky lightness beside it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Amatic SC runs one single stroke width through its whole alphabet, giving a rustic, hand-lettered look. Noto Sans Adlam does the opposite job: tall, full c, s and z with curve endings kept apart.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hie: Amatic SC keeps curves and straights at a single width, with casual terminals that stop far from the stem. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is a modern sans-serif whose x-height nearly reaches cap height, so it feels sturdy under that scrawl.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic reads clean and modern, with wide openings on its small letters and a pronounced x-height. Amatic SC is best at rustic, quirky character with zero stroke modulation; the body font handles steady text.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Amatic SC has a rounded-nib look with no swelling at the stroke ends. Noto Sans Armenian, a sans-serif with tall, full c, s and z and inviting round openings, gives that quirky hand a polished partner.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-avestan: A pen-like line of constant weight gives Amatic SC its rustic, hand-drawn look. Noto Sans Avestan carries a longer read well, with a pronounced x-height and curve tips that never touch.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Neon-tube lines, rustic and quirky: that is Amatic SC, with every stroke the same consistency. Noto Sans Bassa Vah handles the sturdier work, a contemporary sans whose big midsection and open-jawed c fill each line.
